p5-02 (manual-promote RPC accepts only 3.detail: local_queue_head_routes.py:30,43-48 drops a non-32-hex md5. Probe: a non-hex value, '', a leading space, an int, and None are all dropped. Two gaps. (a) An upper-case md5 passes through unchanged ('5D41...'). Laravel's md5 and its resource keys are lower-case only (AppQyV1ResourceIndexService.php:44 MEDIA_KEY_PATTERN [a-f0-9]{32}), so such an item becomes a second dedup key 'en:5D41...' beside the Laravel task 'en:5d41...', and it gets an upload key that the Laravel index pattern rejects. (b) items[].task bypasses the check. The handler forwards whole item dicts (:54-60), and audio_queue_center.promote_local_head uses a caller-supplied item['task'] as-is (audio_queue_center.py:499-506). An RPC caller can therefore insert a task with any payload.md5, no _local_source, and its own _laravel_base_url, which is the URL the lane validates claims against and posts results to (worker_base.py:719-722, laravel_audio_worker_execution.py:674-677). The route has no explicit relay policy, so it falls to route_policy_matching.default_profile general_action (exposure relay) and is reachable through the Laravel relay. The only UI caller sends {kind?, language, text} only (PycoreApiLocal.ts:429-434).
p5-02 (manual-promote RPC accepts only 3.status_after_fix: done; B1 lower-cases a valid md5, and B2 builds RPC items from a whitelist, so 'task' can no longer be injected

RESTARTTRAY-03 / AOQSD-19 / AOQSD-41 (ru.detail: event_handlers.py:495-511 starts the boot chain with assist_settings, and :436-439 runs apply_assist_runtime in the finally after activate_enabled_audio_lanes. The audio lanes' heartbeat callbacks (capability_sync._toggle_callback, :123) and request_start are therefore enabled only after the restore. The pycore-ai gate (capability_sync.py:30-36) also holds request_start on wait_for_restore, so the two agree at boot. One remote-intake path in pycore-runtime scope is still ungated. The realtime thread starts on the main thread right after the boot chain is spawned (event_handlers.py:512-513). On connect it replays every event since the stored cursor (snapshot_service.py:160-163). apply_head_event then calls worker.request_pull(prefer_remote=True) for the audio lane (:549-550) with no restore or lane-enabled check, unlike wake_workers (:362-371). A wordnew head ticket replayed at boot therefore starts a remote pull while the snapshot is still loading, which breaks R6/§5.4 'cache before any remote access'.

X4 consequence to record for the D7 audio long run (orchestrator): a local task without an md5 ('en:text:hello') and the same word's Laravel task ('en:<md5>') are different whole-Queue dedup keys. Before X4 they coincided when the stored word was lower-case. The word cache lookup is by word text, so a second synthesis should not happen, but the Queue can hold both entries. The X4 ruling accepts this; check it in the PRAO-38 run.

event_handlers.py:436-439: translation and STT now also wait for the audio-lane restore, because apply_assist_runtime runs as a whole at the end of the boot chain. That is still needed at boot for the audio lanes' heartbeat callbacks (_toggle_callback enables them immediately; the pycore-ai gate covers only request_start). A later split would remove the delay: enable the audio-lane callbacks after the restore and translation/STT at once. This is a design note for pycore-runtime with pycore-ai.

event_handlers.py:509-511: if start_bus_task itself fails, apply_assist_runtime runs without any restore. The audio lanes then start after the 180 s gate timeout. This happens only on a thread-start failure.

decisions: Recommended option: verdict changes_requested rather than approval with notes. B2 and B3 are behavior defects in pycore-runtime files: a relay-reachable bypass of the X4 check, and a remote pull before the cache restore at boot. B4 turned a logged boot failure into a silent one. B1 and B5 are one-source gaps inside the items' own intent.

Recommended option for B4: fix it once in the foundation (pycore-lead F-1) rather than restoring an except in event_handlers. That keeps AOQSD-36 (no try/except) and fixes every fire-and-forget bus task.

Recommended option for B3: gate the wake at the pycore-runtime call site with the existing wake_workers condition plus restore_complete. A central gate in the audio worker (pycore-ai) is an option for the coordinator later.
The EOL normalization of the 7 lines is accepted: it restores the file's own CRLF, as recorded in the history above.
